company.verification: The Ministry of Food Processing Industries and Food Corporation of India stated that the website was not authorized.

mofpi.finding: MoFPI stated that it had not advertised the recruitment posts and did not have the website fpci.org.in.

fci.finding: FCI stated that fpci.org.in was a fake recruitment website and that the advertisement had no relation to FCI recruitment.
fci.source: Official FCI public notice on recruitment fraud

official_verification.purpose: Used as the legitimate FCI recruitment reference

red_flags: False association with a government-related organization
Recruitment advertisement not authorized by the relevant government organization
Applicants were asked to submit applications and make payment
Fake website presented an online job application section
Website used the name Food Processing Corporation of India

assessment.conclusion: The available official government notices strongly indicate that fpci.org.in was an unauthorized fake recruitment website.
assessment.limitation: This OSINT investigation identifies indicators based on publicly available evidence and does not independently establish criminal liability.
